licence: Government of Pakistan provinces / UNICEF publication
latest_available_wave: Punjab MICS 2024 (fieldwork Dec 2023-Feb 2024; Key Findings Report Dec 2024)
currency_note: Punjab only: the 2017-18 wave is superseded by MICS 2024.
